title: Beyond Green Ornamental Plant Robustness Metrics Demo
description: This storyboard keeps the first three presentation slides and then follows the five high-resolution processing stages used for the ornamental plant detection demo from frame 4 onward.

slides.title: Beyond Green: Annotation-Free Robustness Metrics for Non-Green Ornamental Plant Detection
Detection Pipeline Demo Frame
slides.caption: Opening frame from the original project demo video, showing the UAV perspective over burgundy Loropetalum rows before the downstream detection and robustness analysis stages are presented.

slides.title: Annotation-Free Robustness Framework
slides.caption: System overview covering UAV image acquisition, adaptive color segmentation, shadow and soil removal, morphological cleanup, watershed-based instance grouping, and the annotation-free evaluation metrics RCS, CSC, SVS, and ARI.

slides.title: Color Segmentation
slides.caption: High-resolution binary canopy segmentation showing the first dense extraction of burgundy ornamental plant regions from the UAV scene.

slides.title: Morphological Cleaning
slides.caption: High-resolution cleaned mask after the structural filtering stage removes small fragments and preserves the plant instances used in later counting.

slides.title: Distance Transform
slides.caption: High-resolution distance-transform response emphasizing the instance centers inside the cleaned ornamental canopy regions.

slides.title: Final Labels
slides.caption: High-resolution connected-label map showing the instance-separated plant regions retained for the final counting result.

slides.title: Final Detection
slides.caption: High-resolution final detection overlay showing the complete box-based count over the ornamental rows.
